passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.py: wǒ zěn yàng cái néng bǎo chí jiàn kāng？

phrases.en: I do not look at a screen for too long.
phrases.ko: 나는 화면을 너무 오래 보지 않아요.
phrases.zh: 我看屏幕的时间不会太长。
phrases.py: wǒ kàn píng mù de shí jiān bú huì tài cháng。

phrases.en: I rest when I am tired.
phrases.py: wǒ lèi le jiù xiū xī。
wǒ zhào gù zì jǐ de shēn tǐ。
wǒ kě yǐ jīn tiān jiù kāi shǐ。

phrases.en: Playing outside is better than a long time on a screen.
phrases.ko: 바깥에서 노는 것은 화면을 오래 보는 것보다 나아요.
phrases.zh: 在外面玩，比长时间看屏幕更好。
phrases.py: zài wài miàn wán， bǐ zhǎng shí jiān kàn píng mù gèng hǎo。

phrases.en: When I am tired, rest helps me stay healthy.
phrases.ko: 피곤할 때 쉬는 것은 건강을 유지하도록 도와줘요.
phrases.zh: 我累的时候，休息帮助我保持健康。
phrases.py: wǒ lèi de shí hòu， xiū xī bāng zhù wǒ bǎo chí jiàn kāng。

phrases.en: I care for my body with water, play, and rest.
phrases.ko: 나는 물, 놀이, 쉼으로 몸을 돌봐요.
phrases.zh: 我用水、玩耍和休息来照顾身体。
phrases.py: wǒ yòng shuǐ、 wán shuǎ hé xiū xī lái zhào gù shēn tǐ。

phrases.en: Today is a good day to start.
phrases.py: jīn tiān shì kāi shǐ de hǎo rì zi。

full_passage_spoken: How can I stay healthy? I drink water. I play outside. I do not look at a screen for too long. I rest when I am tired. I care for my body. I can start today. Playing outside is better than a long time on a screen. When I am tired, rest helps me stay healthy. I care for my body with water, play, and rest. Today is a good day to start.
topic_pinyin: zěn yàng bǎo chí jiàn kāng
full_passage_zh: 我怎样才能保持健康？我喝水。我在外面玩。我看屏幕的时间不会太长。我累了就休息。我照顾自己的身体。我可以今天就开始。在外面玩，比长时间看屏幕更好。我累的时候，休息帮助我保持健康。我用水、玩耍和休息来照顾身体。今天是开始的好日子。
